finalText: All 12 stale call sites (in `analytics/cohort.js`, `orders/returnService.js`, `orders/shipment.js`, `billing/refund.js`, `billing/couponService.js`, `support/macroAdmin.js`, `support/sla.js`, `catalog/variantAdmin.js`, `catalog/supplier.js`, `accounts/teamService.js`, `accounts/apiKeyAdmin.js`, `accounts/session.js`) are now migrated to `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Left `cache.query` calls and the vendored `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched, and `verify.js` confirms the migration is complete and nothing else broke.
